binding_contract.normalizer_me_wanted: Tie high for unqualified normalization when the CAP collar owns ME qualification; do not restore the me_en AND before CAP.
binding_contract.source_me_wanted: Original supply/idle/wake/reset intent; PINREG=1 uses pr_mmo_q for the original me_mem_ok_i.
binding_contract.no_lease_feedback: Never feed native_me_lease through PINREG me_mem_ok and then treat the result as original intent.
binding_contract.captured_zero_to_live_one: Admission of a frame captured with me_frame=0 must keep ME execution and go/take bookkeeping disabled even if original intent rises to1. The global native clock alone cannot replace lease qualification.
binding_contract.ownership: Entire core and sequencer native clocks, effective ME execution and acceptance, and collective peers must participate in the same checked epoch.
binding_contract.writes: Capture an immutable PRE frame; read old data first; write in ME,MX,SU,reducer,sequencer order; wait for postverified ACK before native advancement.
